selected_records.title: HexaGripper: A Single-Actuator, Winch-Deployed Gripper for Autonomous Aerial Parcel Collection

article.body:
HexaGripper paper describes winch-deployed parcel gripper

An arXiv paper titled “HexaGripper: A Single-Actuator, Winch-Deployed Gripper for Autonomous Aerial Parcel Collection” identifies a gripper concept for aerial parcel collection. The available record does not specify an aircraft platform, autonomy stack, sensor suite or operating domain.

It provides no reported test results, safety figures, deployment status, fleet or regulatory approval. The title alone does not establish that the gripper has been tested in service or that a parcel-delivery operation exists.
